look_here_first: Start with texture: black-eyed Susan is conspicuously rough-hairy on stems and leaves. Then confirm yellow rays around a dark brown-purple raised disk. Unlike R. amplexicaulis, its leaves do not clasp the stem.

key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Biennial or short-lived perennial, sometimes flowering first year.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Variable; basal lanceolate to elliptic, stem leaves linear to ovate-lanceolate; rough-hairy.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Yellow rays around a dark purplish-brown hemispheric/ovoid disk.
